visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a bright office hallway, a man wearing a blue cap and white t-shirt sits next to a person with short black hair and glasses wearing a patterned yellow shirt. They are being interviewed with a 'HahaTai' branded microphone. (2) The scene cuts to a indoor domestic setting where a tabby cat jumps onto a wooden door handle, using its body weight to pull it down and open the door. (3) Back in the office, the man in the blue cap gestures animatedly while sharing a story, laughing alongside the person in the patterned shirt. (4) A close-up shows the person with glasses smiling warmly while scrolling through a phone; then a brief shot of a cat sleeping under a blanket is shown. (5) A woman with short dark hair in a white 'is the all' printed t-shirt is interviewed in a professional office background with a bookshelf. (6) Montage shots of dogs in poor conditions: one tied with a heavy chain in a blue barrel, another barking in a small metal cage, and one very thin dog eating on a plastic grid floor. (7) The woman in the white shirt continues her interview, looking serious and gesturing towards a document on the screen. (8) An older man with glasses in a light grey button-down shirt is interviewed in a hallway setting, speaking calmly to the off-screen interviewer. (9) The video ends with a white screen displaying logos for TAIWAN SPCA and the Ministry of Agriculture, along with promotional text.

It starts with lighthearted street interviews to engage viewers, then shifts to a serious tone by showcasing animal abuse cases and explaining relevant laws and penalties with help from government officials and NGOs.
